newsitem.title: UK: UK Housing Corp bidders to be announced shortly.
newsitem.headline: UK Housing Corp bidders to be announced shortly.

text.p: The names of shortlisted bidders for the 1.1 billion stg loan portfolio of Britain's housing corporations are expected to be announced "in the next few days", the Environment Department said in a statement.

Environment Secretary John Gummer earlier announced the government had decided to proceed with the sale of loans with a face value of 926 million stg for the Housing Corporation, 93 million for Scottish Homes and 59 million for Housing for Wales.

"(Government financial advisers N.M.) Rothschilds are expected to announce the names of shortlisted bidders for the portfolios in the next few days," the statement said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
